title: Australia-China Joint Statement on Climate Change and the Clean Energy Transition
summary: The Commonwealth of Australia and the People's Republic of China (hereinafter referred to as "the two sides'') reaffirm their joint efforts to support global climate action and unlock the economic opportunities of the global clean energy transition.
